From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@bellavista.health>

Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Lab sprint coordination: prompt review, load-test window & pre-reads

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on lab for the POC. We want to land a single focused working session that covers: prompt review and tuning, routing/variant checks, and a short load-test window to validate throughput and latency before the formal evaluation.

Proposed time (single 90-min block):
- Tue Sep 8, 2026 — 11:00am–12:30pm PT (2:00–3:30pm ET)

High-level agenda (draft):
- 10 min: introductions + goals
- 25 min: prompt & output quality walkthrough (we'll bring the prompt table)
- 25 min: routing/variant behavior & KV cache checks
- 25 min: controlled load test (short bursts) + quick readout
- 5 min: next steps / open actions

Attachments included: Slide-deck-lab-agenda.pptx (slides), POC_Runbook_v1.pdf (runbook/checklist), Loadtest-plan.csv (load test parameters).

Pre-read request (please review before the session):
- The slide deck (attached) — orient to goals and expected outcomes
- Runbook: roles & what we will exercise (look for the "test data" section)
- If you can, upload one representative sample request/utterance we should include in the prompt sweep.

A couple questions so we can prep:
1) Can you confirm the dataset we'll use for the short load window (anonymized sample OK)?
2) Are there any network controls (allowlisting) we should plan for with your staging environment?

If Sep 8 works I will send the calendar invite and follow up with a short checklist for your team. If not, propose two alternatives and we will pivot.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: Slide-deck-lab-agenda.pptx (pptx)
Attachment: POC_Runbook_v1.pdf (pdf)

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks — appreciate the clear agenda. I have a calendar conflict on Sep 8 at that time (leadership review).
Would Sep 9, 2026 between 10:30–12:00 PT work for your team instead? If not I can do Sep 10 morning as a second option.

Quick notes on questions:
- We can provide an anonymized sample payload (I will send a small CSV) — please confirm how you want it transmitted (secure upload or SFTP).
- For the short load window we prefer that you hit our staging endpoints (staging.bellavista.health). We will open a CIDR / firewall rule but need an ETA so I can request the change.

Also — do you need any production-level tokens, or will test keys suffice?

-Tom

Looping in internal owners — we can accommodate Sep 9 10:30–12:00 PT (that maps to Tom's ask).

Proposed updated time:
- Wed Sep 9, 2026 — 10:30am–12:00pm PT (90 min)

Operational notes / assignments:
- Ben: please own the load test orchestration (short bursts, 5–10s ramps, 2x model variants). Use Loadtest-plan.csv and confirm generator IPs for allowlist.
- Dev: you own model routing checks and prompt sweep script. Please prepare a one-page prompt-table (expected inputs, expected outputs, tolerances).
- Stephanie: send calendar invite, pre-reads (drive link + attachments), and short pre-session checklist for Bellavista.

Draft agenda (timeboxed):
- 10:30–10:40 (10m) — Quick goals & roll call
- 10:40–11:05 (25m) — Prompt review + live examples (Dev leads)
- 11:05–11:30 (25m) — Routing variants & fallback checks (Dev + Ben)
- 11:30–11:55 (25m) — Controlled load bursts + live metrics (Ben leads)
- 11:55–12:00 (5m) — Actions & follow-ups

Pre-session checklist (we will circulate formally):
- Bellavista to provide anonymized CSV sample by Sep 3
- Firewall/CIDR allowlist requested by Sep 7 (Ben will provide IPs)
- Test keys vs prod keys: test keys preferred; if you need to use short-lived prod tokens, we will coordinate with your security team.

Ben/Dev — can you confirm IPs and that the prompt-table will be ready by Sep 6?

Thanks —
